title: Question 3.3b: Understanding Hashing Concept
instruction: Hashing is a technique that converts data into a fixed-size value. Think about how this might help when dealing with many different words.
reveal: Hashing converts each word into a number between 0 and 9999 using a hash function. This is more efficient than keeping a list of all possible words because: (1) we don't need to store the vocabulary, (2) we can handle new words we haven't seen before, and (3) it's faster. The trade-off is that different words might hash to the same number (called a collision), but this is usually acceptable for machine learning.
